import importlib.util
import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
sys.path.insert(0, 'repository')
import public_tests
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('baseline', 'candidate/B/app/service.py')

spec.loader.exec_module(module)
public_tests.x07_existing(module.run)
try:
    public_tests.x07_feature(module.run)
except AssertionError:
    print('Baseline: existing behavior passes; feature absent.')
else:
    raise AssertionError('Baseline unexpectedly implements feature')
expected = {'B/app/service.py', 'feature.patch', 'security.patch'}
actual = {str(p.relative_to('candidate')) for p in Path('candidate').rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
assert actual == expected, actual
for name in expected:
    p = Path('candidate') / name
    data = p.read_bytes()
    data.decode('utf-8')
    assert b'\\0' not in data
    assert not p.stat().st_mode & 0o111
assert len({Path(p).read_bytes() for p in ['candidate/B/app/service.py', '.scratch/U/app/service.py', '.scratch/R/app/service.py']}) == 3
assert Path('.scratch/applied/app/service.py').read_bytes() == Path('.scratch/R/app/service.py').read_bytes()
print('Artifact set, encoding, permissions, distinctness, and applied result verified.')
PY"
